## Description (suggested)

Priority bundle freezing the theory stack of an ongoing AI-assisted campaign
on the plane Jacobian Conjecture (D. Clemens Posch with Claude/Fable,
Anthropic; GPT-family and Grok-family models as co-researchers and hostile
reviewers). SUMMARY.pdf (10 pages) states the promoted theorem stack
precisely, with evidence tiers, scope riders, and adversarial review chains,
and points into the bundle: Theorem A (the strip rigidity lemma, found
independently via the Duistermaat-van der Kallen mechanism; priority
Zoladek 2008/Liouville) and the uniform strip obstruction theory at all
cells (k, d2 >= 2) in characteristic zero; the sheet-number ladder in the
Sigray frame, book-relative throughout: the td <= 5 closure on the canonical
book, the td = 6 funnel to the unique coefficient-tier two-pole residue-A
template (one live cell among the open sectors listed below), the
td = 7 off-axis book empty at the tower tier on the filed 17-cell perimeter
(uniform tower theorem, 1559-check machine gate, dual review), the td = 11
conditional emptiness certificate (411-row census; conditional on the named
fail-closed classes FC1-R and FC3), and the td = 12 type-(3,5)
first-death-refusal book (14/14 cells at the honest, list-relative tier);
the normal-form lemma suite NF-Z/NF-D/NF-M/NF-P, including the
closed-as-refuted neutral-word quotient program (the negative record is
kept deliberately) and the merged-emission law w' = kbar(d_q-1)/(nu d_q),
M' = gcd(d_p, d_q); the banked depth-stabilization lemma for the residue-A
window system (first-lemma tier: depth-free kill direction;
Tougeron/Greenberg effective decision constant 2e+1); and the
honestly-stated current residue-A record: the depth-21 window is nonempty
mod p at three primes (397-element Groebner basis, 13-dimensional fiber
locus) while all 12 sampled points die at depth 23, with the deciding
depth-23 computation still running at bundling time (verdict pending, and
stated as pending). Residue-A is the current compute target, not the whole
live inventory: the filed ladder's live frontier is residue-A plus the
unadjudicated above-bound entries (td 8, 10, 12-(2,3)/(2,5), 14), joined by
the td = 6 single-pole classes, generic off-axis entries, and every td
above the enumerated range. The bundle includes the campaign's own hostile
foundations audit (REDUCTION.md: the end-to-end reduction from a Keller
counterexample to an enumerated book entry is NOT yet a theorem, with the
ranked gap list), a pre-Laurent T2-to-T4 simultaneous-normalization theorem
for the GGV-selected pair (Conjecture T, corner-to-tree, remains open; this
is not a closure of the G2 transport gap), the full adversarial review
corpus (xmodel/, both reviewer
families, including the reviews that broke claims), the exact-arithmetic
gate suites re-deriving every promoted arithmetic claim (VERIFICATION.md:
one command per suite with expected counts; all pure Python 3 standard
library; all exit 0; about four minutes total, self-containment tested from
inside the bundle), and the frozen certificate data (tower certificates,
the residue-A CORE2/D23/compatibility cores at the three banked primes, the
depth-21 fiber Groebner basis and sample points, the a3-chamber double-EMPTY
pair). Excluded for size: the multi-megabyte raw window emissions superseded
by the compressed cores, the raw model session transcripts (~82 MB) behind
the xmodel review documents, and the (72,108) runs/systems trees, which
belong to the paper-1 artifact line. Nothing in this bundle claims a proof
of the plane Jacobian Conjecture; it timestamps intermediate theorems,
certificates, and the honest gap record of the campaign.
